column1: # Compact English word-frequency dictionary used for local perplexity estimation.
# Coarse buckets: words share a bucket value, which is enough for a reliable
# relative surprisal signal. Tokens missing from this file are treated as rare
# (log-frequency 0.0). Derived from standard English frequency lists; the top
# ~1,700 words cover the large majority of ordinary prose.
# Bucket 7.0 - the most common words in English
